name: P-009 live: the Asana card on Settings -> Integrations registers an OAuth client through the generic clientRegistrationRef form, enables Connect without revealing the secret, and offers the declared personal-access-token option
command: (launched by .papercusp/scratch/p009-fixtures/launch-p009.sh with VERIFY_TAURI_ISOLATED_DB=1, VERIFY_TAURI_ISOLATED_SEED=ready, a private PAPERCUSP_HOME, VERIFY_TAURI_SOURCE_REF pinned and the acceptance inputs checked byte-identical to that ref)
summary: verify-tauri-headless run 20261011T111424Z-2494115 verdict=pass (passed=3 failed=0 blocked=0 skipped=0), isolated DB and private PAPERCUSP_HOME, superproject c20d6c21f9, libs/papercusp 7c0fa73eec. Before registration the Asana card's OAuth client form read configured=false with Connect disabled and showed the redirect URI to paste into the vendor console, plus a Client ID text input and a masked Client secret input. After filling and saving the form on the page, the card read configured=true with Connect enabled, showed the client id and did not render the secret. The registration route answered 200 with configured:true and hasClientSecret:true; the registration landed in the private home's oauth-apps.json and the host's own registration file was byte-identical before and after (sha256 ec07b63d...). The card also offered the manifest-declared personal_access_token credential as a masked, unconfigured input.

assertions.evidence: BEFORE_REGISTRATION configured=false connect=disabled redirect=http://127.0.0.1:33720/api/oauth/callback inputs=Client ID:text|Client secret:password
OK registered through the form (fields filled and Save clicked in the webview, not via a direct API call).

REGISTRATION_READ 200 {ok:true, providerId:asana, oauthClient:{ref:asana, configured:true, clientId:p009client2365714998, hasClientSecret:true, redirectUri:http://127.0.0.1:33720/api/oauth/callback}} — the secret itself is never returned.
OK private registration file <private PAPERCUSP_HOME>/oauth-apps.json; OK host registration unchanged sha256=ec07b63de131c5ecd906dd1889751e8941766da57a2ed76186a08cf3488e550b (before == after).
PAT_OPTION personal_access_token:false:password — the setup.credentials field declared in libs/papercusp/plugins/asana/papercusp.json renders as a masked, unconfigured input on the same card.

limitations: The registered client id/secret are test values; completing an Asana OAuth consent needs a browser sign-in at app.asana.com, which a headless run cannot give, so the token exchange is covered by the unit/integration tests, not here.
Saving a personal access token is not exercised live here: the run shows the option exists and is masked; the credential connect path (D-016) is exercised by the P-010 live run.

The first attempt (run 20261011T111319Z-2462500) aborted in prepare (operator-source-snapshot exit 1) because a tested input was uncommitted; the launcher waited for git-sync and the second attempt is the one recorded.
